title: Mitigating Over-Optimization in PRM-Guided Search in Mathematical Reasoning by Optimizing the Guide
abstract: arXiv:2608.30051v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) provide dense step-level guidance for search-based reasoning, enabling inference-time compute to be allocated toward promising partial solutions. However, recent evidence suggests that PRM-guided search can over-optimize imperfect process rewards, pruning viable trajectories while expanding spurious ones. In this work, we theoretically show that directly leveraging PRM score is vulnerable to verifier noise through an extreme-value effect: non-viable prefixes become more likely to receive spuriously high scores as reasoning depth increase. Therefore, we formulate the PRM-guided search as a robust optimization problem over plausible reward perturbations, termed maximin PRM-guided search, leading to a training-free robust process supervision method that preserves promising alternatives when step-level scores are noisy. Maximin PRM-guided search mitigates this failure mode by reducing sensitivity to over-optimize

translated_title: 通过优化引导器缓解数学推理中PRM引导搜索的过度优化问题
translated_abstract: 过程奖励模型（PRM）为基于搜索的推理提供了密集的步骤级引导，使推理时的计算资源能够被分配到有前景的部分解上。然而，最近的证据表明，PRM引导的搜索可能会对不完善的过程奖励进行过度优化，剪除可行的轨迹，同时扩展虚假的轨迹。在本工作中，我们通过极值效应从理论上证明，直接利用PRM分数容易受到验证器噪声的影响：随着推理深度的增加，不可行的前缀更有可能获得虚假的高分。因此，我们将PRM引导的搜索形式化为一个针对合理奖励扰动的鲁棒优化问题，称为极大极小PRM引导搜索（maximin PRM-guided search），由此产生了一种无需训练的鲁棒过程监督方法，能够在步骤级分数存在噪声时保留有前景的备选方案。Maximin PRM引导搜索通过降低对过度优化的敏感性来缓解这一失效模式。
tldr: 该论文提出“极大极小PRM引导搜索”方法，将PRM引导的搜索形式化为针对奖励扰动的鲁棒优化问题，以无需训练的方式缓解数学推理中对不完善过程奖励的过度优化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "maximin PRM-guided search," a training-free robust optimization formulation over plausible reward perturbations that mitigates over-optimization of imperfect process rewards in PRM-guided search for mathematical reasoning.
